title.en: Resistivity and the combination of resistors

text.en: On a string of old fairy lights, if one bulb fails the whole string goes dark. In your house, if one bulb fails the fan keeps running. The first is a series circuit and the second is a parallel circuit.

The resistance of a wire depends on its resistivity, length and area of cross section, so resistivity rho = R A / L, measured in ohm metre.
Conductors such as copper have very small resistivity, about 1.62 times 10 to the power minus 8 ohm metre, while insulators such as glass and rubber have a very large resistivity.
The reciprocal of resistance is conductance, measured in mho, and the reciprocal of resistivity is conductivity.
In a series circuit the resistors are joined end to end in a single loop, so the same current flows through each of them.
The potential differences add up, V = V1 + V2 + V3, which gives the effective resistance Rs = R1 + R2 + R3.
The equivalent resistance of a series combination is greater than the highest individual resistance, and for n equal resistors it is n R.
In a parallel circuit there are two or more loops, the potential difference across each resistor is the same and the currents add, I = I1 + I2 + I3.
The effective resistance is given by 1 / Rp = 1 / R1 + 1 / R2 + 1 / R3, and it is less than the lowest individual resistance.
Series-parallel and parallel-series combinations are solved in steps: first replace each group by its effective resistance and then combine the groups.
In a series circuit if one appliance is disconnected the others stop working, but in a parallel circuit they work independently, which is why house wiring is parallel.

problem.en: Three resistors of 5 ohm, 3 ohm and 2 ohm are connected in series across a 10 V battery. Find the effective resistance and the current. Then find the effective resistance if 6 ohm and 3 ohm are connected in parallel.

text.en: Series: Rs = R1 + R2 + R3 = 5 + 3 + 2 = 10 ohm.
So Rp = 2 ohm, which is less than the smaller resistor, 3 ohm.

prompt.en: A wire of length 10 m and area 2 x 10^-7 m2 has a resistance of 2 ohm. Find its resistivity.

commonMisconceptions.en: Using the length in the numerator
Forgetting that the unit is ohm metre

points.en: Series: Rs = R1 + R2 + R3, same current, Rs is the largest.
Parallel: 1/Rp = sum of reciprocals, same voltage, Rp is the smallest.
rho = R A / L in ohm metre.
House wiring is parallel so appliances work independently.
